name: Bill Williams
summary: This EA implements the Bill Williams trading system, utilizing Alligator, Fractals, Awesome Oscillator, and Accelerator Oscillator to identify momentum-based trading opportunities. It enters trades when multiple Bill Williams indicators align to confirm trend direction and momentum shifts. The system follows Bill Williams' Chaos Theory principles for market analysis and trade execution.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了比尔·威廉姆斯交易系统，利用鳄鱼指标、分形指标、动量震荡指标和加速震荡指标来识别基于动量的交易机会。当多个威廉姆斯指标同向确认趋势方向和动量转变时入场交易。该系统遵循比尔·威廉姆斯混沌理论原则进行市场分析和交易执行。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯混沌理论，综合运用多个指标进行交易决策。入场条件：鳄鱼指标嘴唇、牙齿、下巴排列确认趋势方向，分形突破作为入场触发信号，动量震荡指标(AO)和加速震荡指标(AC)同向确认动量方向。出场条件：当鳄鱼指标收敛或分形反向突破时平仓，也可设置固定止损止盈。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算。资金管理方面，该EA依赖多指标协同确认以降低虚假信号风险，但缺少动态仓位调整和追踪止损等高级资金管理功能。整体策略逻辑清晰，但指标滞后性可能导致入场延迟，在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on Bill Williams' Chaos Theory, combining multiple indicators for trading decisions. Entry conditions: Alligator indicator's Lips, Teeth, and Jaw alignment confirms trend direction, Fractal breakout serves as the entry trigger, and Awesome Oscillator (AO) and Accelerator Oscillator (AC) align to confirm momentum direction. Exit conditions: Positions close when the Alligator lines converge or when an opposite fractal breakout occurs, with optional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or percentage-based calculation on account balance. Money management relies on multi-indicator confluence to reduce false signals, but lacks advanced features like dynamic position sizing and trailing stops. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-structured, but indicator lag may cause delayed entries, and false signals are common during ranging markets without clear trend direction.

parameters.description: 是否使用加速震荡指标过滤

pros: 多指标协同确认，减少虚假信号
基于经典混沌理论，策略逻辑有理论支撑
指标组合可灵活开关，适应不同市场环境
分形突破入场机制明确，执行规则清晰
支持止损止盈设置，具备基础风险控制
pros_en: Based on well-established Chaos Theory with solid theoretical foundation
Flexible indicator toggles adapt to different market conditions
Clear fractal breakout entry mechanism with well-defined execution rules
Supports stop-loss and take-profit for basic risk control
cons: 威廉姆斯指标存在滞后性，入场可能延迟
震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少追踪止损功能，盈利头寸可能大幅回吐
固定手数仓位管理不够灵活，未考虑波动率调整
未包含新K线检查，可能在同一K线重复开仓
cons_en: Bill Williams indicators are lagging, causing delayed entries
Prone to false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may give back significant gains
Fixed lot sizing is inflexible without volatility-based adjustment
Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same candle
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能以保护浮动盈利
添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易
实现基于ATR的动态仓位管理和止损设置
添加新K线检查防止同一K线重复开仓
增加资金管理模块，支持基于风险百分比的仓位计算
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits
Incorporate ADX or volatility filter to reduce trades in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic position sizing and stop-loss placement
Add new bar check to prevent repeated entries on the same candle
Add money management module supporting risk-percentage-based position sizing

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次开仓
无追踪止损在趋势反转时盈利回吐风险较大
震荡行情中指标失效可能产生连续亏损
固定止损为0时存在无止损风险
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same candle
No trailing stop poses significant profit give-back risk on trend reversals
Indicator failure in ranging markets may produce consecutive losses
StopLoss default of 0 creates risk of positions without stop-loss protection
